purpose.zh: 拉开胯前面，久坐发紧时松一松
purpose.en: Stretches the front of your hip to ease tightness from sitting.

text.zh: 夹紧屁股，身子慢慢往前推

text.zh: 后膝跪地，前脚踩地，上身直立。
text.en: Back knee down, front foot planted, upper body tall.

text.zh: 后膝下面垫软，后腿那边胯前面一路被拉开。
text.en: Pad the back knee and feel the front of that hip open.

text.zh: 呼气时屁股夹得更紧一点，身子往前挪一点点。
text.en: Each breath out, squeeze your butt harder and shift forward a little.

commonErrors.zh: 身子往前冲，腰往前折，屁股松着
commonErrors.en: Lunging forward with your back bent and your butt loose.
Front knee shooting far past your toes.

cautions.zh: 跪着的膝盖下面垫软垫
胯前面疼就推少点，还疼就停
cautions.en: If the front of your hip hurts, don't push as far. Stop if it still hurts.
